zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

tpm_judge.persona_contract: Legendary TPM judge accountable for ensuring UX QA certification is a separate bead after closure and that legal next action comes from TASKS, TPM, PERT, KG, and kernel records.
tpm_judge.rationale: TB-20260426-106 and STEP-NORTHSTAR-006 are present and accepted.

evidence_clerk.persona_contract: Evidence clerk accountable for rejecting QA certification without refreshed tests, screenshots, and structured evidence.
evidence_clerk.rationale: Core, static, accessibility, browser, screenshot, and certificate evidence are present.

standards_juror.persona_contract: Standards juror accountable for ensuring the QA certification boundary is internal DFMS QA, not external vendor certification.
standards_juror.rationale: Certificate states internal/external boundary and revalidation triggers.

domain_artifact_juror.persona_contract: Product/UX juror accountable for mobile ergonomics, brand quality, and workflow usefulness.
domain_artifact_juror.rationale: Mobile shell is compacted, stateful controls are clearer, and brand remains restrained and coherent.

verification_juror.persona_contract: Verification juror accountable for deterministic tests of reliability, accessibility, visual layout, and E2E outcomes.
verification_juror.rationale: normalizeState unit tests, static UI audit, accessibility browser audit, and WYSIWYG E2E passed.

adversarial_prosecutor.persona_contract: Adversarial prosecutor accountable for attacking fake polish, screenshot-only confidence, stale evidence, untested local-state failure, and overclaimed certification.
adversarial_prosecutor.rationale: Concrete product fixes were made and validated; external certification is explicitly out of scope.

jury_foreperson.persona_contract: Foreperson accountable for final verdict, dissent, residual risks, and legal next action.
jury_foreperson.rationale: No open P0/P1 UX QA certification finding remains for this bounded demonstrator.

verdict.next_action: RUN-CLOSED unless a new change request is opened
